properties.name: ssh.host
properties.description: Hostname or IP address of the SSH target server.

properties.name: ssh.port
properties.description: SSH port of the target server. Defaults to 22.

properties.name: ssh.user
properties.description: SSH login username for the target server.

properties.name: ssh.password
properties.description: SSH login password for the target server. Set via SSH_PASSWORD env var.

properties.name: ssh.strict-host-key-checking
properties.description: Whether to enforce SSH host key verification ('yes'/'no'). Defaults to 'no' for containerised environments.

properties.name: ssh.fallback-host
properties.description: Fallback SSH hostname (e.g. ngrok address) used automatically when the primary ssh.host is unreachable. Leave empty to disable fallback. Set via SSH_FALLBACK_HOST env var.

properties.name: ssh.fallback-port
properties.description: Port for the fallback SSH connection (e.g. ngrok forwarded port). Defaults to 22. Set via SSH_FALLBACK_PORT env var.

properties.name: app.auth.username
properties.description: Single-user dashboard login username. MUST be set via APP_AUTH_USERNAME env var.

properties.name: app.auth.password
properties.description: Single-user dashboard login password. MUST be set via APP_AUTH_PASSWORD env var.

properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: HS256 signing secret for JWT tokens. Must be >= 32 characters (256-bit minimum). Set via JWT_SECRET env var.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-hours
properties.description: JWT token validity duration in hours.

properties.name: telegram.bot-token
properties.description: Telegram Bot API token obtained from @BotFather. Set via TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var. Leave empty to disable Telegram integration.

properties.name: telegram.chat-id
properties.description: Telegram chat ID that will receive bot alerts and commands. Set via TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID env var.

properties.name: groq.api-key
properties.description: Groq Cloud API key from https://console.groq.com/keys. Free tier: 30 RPM, 500k tokens/day. Set via GROQ_API_KEY env var.

properties.name: groq.model
properties.description: Groq model for AI chat. Options: llama-3.3-70b-versatile (smart), llama-3.1-8b-instant (fast).
